generated.stem: A treated lactational mastitis in which a discrete mass persists after the systemic illness has settled. Which investigation should be used to characterise this persistent breast mass?

options.text: Targeted breast ultrasonography
Sterile milk culture and sensitivities
Diagnostic mammography
Needle aspiration of the mass without imaging

rationale.key: The reviewed context favors Targeted breast ultrasonography without exposing every hallmark feature.

why_plausible: a test ordered because the illness has not fully resolved on treatment
why_inferior: systemic symptoms that have improved on treatment
what_would_make_correct: Correct where there is no symptomatic improvement after 48 hours of first-line therapy, or where a resistant organism is suspected.
distractors.next_step_if_correct: Correct where there is no symptomatic improvement after 48 hours of first-line therapy, or where a resistant organism is suspected.

why_plausible: cross-sectional imaging of a persistent breast mass
why_inferior: skin that shows no thickening, retraction or peau d'orange

distractors.next_step_if_correct: Correct where the skin findings of inflammatory breast cancer are present, or where a mass persists after complete resolution of inflammation and needs malignancy work-up.

why_plausible: a procedure that would establish whether the mass is a fluid collection
why_inferior: a mass that has not yet been shown to be a fluid collection

generated.stem: An adult with computed-tomography-confirmed perforation and free intraperitoneal fluid rather than a walled-off collection. Which management strategy is most appropriate for this patient with perforated appendicitis and generalised peritonitis?

options.text: Urgent laparoscopic appendectomy
Intravenous antibiotics alone with planned reassessment
Image-guided percutaneous drainage with antibiotics
Antibiotics now with interval appendectomy in six to eight weeks

rationale.key: The reviewed context favors Urgent laparoscopic appendectomy without exposing every hallmark feature.

why_plausible: a definitive management plan for acute appendicitis
why_inferior: perforation with generalised peritonitis rather than uncomplicated disease

distractors.next_step_if_correct: Correct in selected adults with uncomplicated appendicitis who accept a cross-over and recurrence risk.

why_plausible: a strategy explicitly recommended for complicated appendicitis
why_inferior: free intraperitoneal fluid with generalised peritonitis rather than a walled-off collection
what_would_make_correct: Correct where there is a phlegmon or a walled-off abscess at presentation.
distractors.next_step_if_correct: Correct where there is a phlegmon or a walled-off abscess at presentation.

why_plausible: a complete plan that ends in appendectomy
why_inferior: generalised peritonitis, which is not a disease that can be allowed to settle

generated.stem: An emergency assessment of a depressed patient with intent, a plan, retained means and psychotic symptoms. What is the most appropriate disposition for this patient now?

options.text: Arrange emergency psychiatric hospitalization
Complete a collaborative safety plan and discharge with same-day follow-up
Administer a validated suicide risk scale and decide on the score
Start a first-line antidepressant and review in one week

rationale.key: The reviewed context favors Arrange emergency psychiatric hospitalization without exposing every hallmark feature.

why_plausible: an action taken to reduce imminent suicide risk
why_inferior: intent to act together with psychotic symptoms, the combination for which an inpatient setting is warranted
what_would_make_correct: Correct alongside admission, and as a disposition in its own right for a patient who is not at high risk.
distractors.next_step_if_correct: Correct alongside admission, and as a disposition in its own right for a patient who is not at high risk.

why_plausible: a step taken to settle the disposition of an at-risk patient

distractors.next_step_if_correct: Correct only alongside clinician judgment, never as the determinant of disposition.

why_plausible: an action addressing the same depressive illness at the same visit
why_inferior: a delay of weeks to effect against a risk that is present tonight

generated.stem: A screening programme whose confirmatory and treatment capacity is quantified and falls short of the expected volume of positive results. What should the programme do about the planned launch?

Launch as planned with continuing evaluation against programme goals
